Consequence: GT step 9 has a second defensible value. Affected: rx_ext_owed_shipping_payment and rx_ext_cash_shipment_refund overwrite lists; computations step 9. First revision.
2. **SOURCE-POLICY RED — POL-2 on this task.** Base `charge_timing` "When fills and shipping are charged: at_shipment." is not overwritten by rx_ext_owed_shipping_payment; reading C (no shipping charged after the Oct 9 shipment; refund of the drug overcharge 13.35 alone) yields a different terminal state (no shipping line). Affected: rx_ext_owed_shipping_payment `overwrite` / `base_policy_refs`; GT step 9. First revision.
3. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — FAC-1 on this task.** weekend_transit_fee (Friday overnight 8.00) engaged in steps 9 and 11; unreal ladder (`_difficulty.md` → FAC-1). Struck, step 9 keeps 3 factors (< 4); step 11 keeps 4. First revision.
